popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Periboea daughter of Hipponous the second wife of Oeneus and mother of Tydeus — the Calydonian queen behind the father of Diomedes.

popCulture.title: Periboea
popCulture.description: Wife of Oeneus, mother of Tydeus — carefully distinct from the Corinthian foster-mother of Oedipus and from the naiad mother of Penelope.

popCulture.title: Tydeus
popCulture.description: Periboea's son by Oeneus — the Aetolian exile who becomes one of the Seven and father of Diomedes.

popCulture.title: Oeneus
popCulture.description: Periboea's husband — king of Calydon, father of Meleager by Althaea and of Tydeus by Periboea in the standard stemma.
